database.name: European sections (compiled, unverified)
database.description: European and UK hot rolled sections compiled from the published tables of the ArcelorMittal Orange Book and the SCI Blue Book, hollow sections from the eurocodepy package, alongside hand-written channels, angles, plates, bars and fasteners. Millimetres and kilograms per metre.
database.notes: NOT VERIFIED. Every record carries "verified": false and names its source. The compiled records were produced mechanically by tools/data-sources/compile_sections.py from a third party package, not from a controlled copy of any standard. Verify against your own authoritative source before using any output for procurement or fabrication.
